name: CollegeNET
ownership_status: Rubicon Technology Partners majority-backed; founder Jim Wolfston continues to lead and remains a significant shareholder
positioning: Unified academic and event scheduling suite with room optimization and utilization reporting
price_scope: NOCCCD 25Live annual license for FY2024-25 through FY2026-27
pricing_notes: Public contract evidence is institution-specific: 160000 USD implementation in FY2023-24 plus 48000 USD in FY2024-25; not list pricing
integrations: Bidirectional SIS via LYNX; APIs; SSO; calendar publishing
strengths: Broad suite spans event intake through academic room optimization; live conflict checks; mature higher-ed footprint
weaknesses: Evidence shows requester-edit friction and performance/data freshness issues in some institutional configurations; advanced optimization is a separate Schedule25 product

name: Accruent
ownership_status: Accruent operating company; EMS acquired by Accruent in 2018; Fortive remains parent in 2026
positioning: Classroom exam event and workspace scheduling within a facilities software portfolio
price_scope: Lincoln Land Community College EMS Campus 2025-2029 maintenance
pricing_notes: Public board amount is contract-specific and rises from 20717.49 USD in 2025 by 4 percent annually
integrations: Banner; Colleague; PowerCampus; PeopleSoft; Jenzabar; Workday; Microsoft 365; Zoom
strengths: Detailed academic planning workflow; broad room/event functions; many reports; facilities portfolio adjacency
weaknesses: Connector behavior varies by SIS: current Workday platform documentation says data is pulled into EMS but not synchronized back; reviews report dated UI and support/service friction

name: Coursedog
ownership_status: Privately operated; received strategic growth investment led by JMI Equity and Gregg Scoresby
positioning: Connected curriculum academic scheduling event management catalog and workload modules
pricing_model: Modular subscription implementation training and hardware quote
price_scope: Oakton College package included academic scheduling room and event scheduling faculty workload demand projections Banner implementation training maintenance licenses and hardware
pricing_notes: Year 1 was 173244 USD followed by 100463; 105486; 110758; and 116298 USD; not list pricing
notable_customers: Oakton College; Villanova University; Drew University
integrations: SIS integration; SSO; Banner integration documented by institutions
strengths: Modern web workflows; optimizer with weighted rules; demand projections; modular academic and event products
weaknesses: Institution-specific known issues include incomplete visibility into prerequisites/restrictions and inaccurate analytics; optimizer and room behavior have documented scope limits

name: Ad Astra
ownership_status: Founder-led private company; Tom Shaver listed as founder and CEO
positioning: Data-informed academic course room and event scheduling with modular demand and pathway tools
pricing_model: Modular subscription implementation and integration quote
price_scope: College of the Florida Keys scope included academic scheduling Banner integration demand forecasting pathway management and registration monitoring
pricing_notes: Contract total calculated from public statement of work: 77110 USD initial amount due including implementation plus 51828.40 and 53901.54 subscription years; room exam and event scheduling were expressly out of scope
integrations: Banner via Ellucian Ethos; other SIS integrations; APIs
strengths: Strong demand/pathway framing; academic scheduling; separate room optimization and event modules; published permissions and workflow controls
weaknesses: Modules and implementation services expand scope and cost; vendor agreement assigns custom API ownership and source-data quality work to the institution

name: Infosilem
ownership_status: Infosilem Inc. is a Berger-Levrault Group subsidiary
positioning: Integrated academic timetabling campus booking and exam scheduling
integrations: Ellucian Ethos bidirectional near-real-time; API; CSV
strengths: Automated and manual timetable construction; pathway and preference constraints; campus bookings; exam scheduling; detailed room rules
weaknesses: Public proof is largely vendor-authored; reviewers report a steep learning curve and multi-click simple changes

name: CourseLeaf
ownership_status: Private company; current ownership not independently verified
positioning: Academic section scheduling and workflow with SIS and room-system integrations
integrations: Bidirectional SIS; integrations with 25Live and EMS
strengths: Strong academic section workflow; rules; demand analytics; finals; reserved seats
weaknesses: Room and event operations are positioned through integrations rather than a complete native campus booking suite
